summary:
## Standing operator rules
Never create or modify a Stripe webhook without placing the ADR link in #billing-integrations and tagging @priya. Do not raise the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50 again; it caused staging lock contention and deadlocks. In between other work, run `enterprise-tenant-onboarding` one step at a time, in order:
1. `tenantctl requests validate REQ-2025-01842 --org-id org_acme_industries --plan enterprise-annual --currency USD`
2. `tenantctl organizations create --id org_acme_industries --name 'Acme Industries' --domain acme.example --plan enterprise-annual`
3. `tenantctl db migrate org_acme_industries --path ./migrations/enterprise --to-version 0042 --wait`
4. `tenantctl db seed org_acme_industries --file ./seeds/acme-enterprise-v3.json --conflict-key external_id --dry-run=false`
5. `tenantctl billing customers ensure --org-id org_acme_industries --legal-name 'Acme Industries, Inc.' --email billing@acme.example --currency USD`
6. `tenantctl mail send --org-id org_acme_industries --template enterprise-welcome-v2 --to admin@acme.example --request REQ-2025-01842`
7. `tenantctl billing invoices create --org-id org_acme_industries --description 'Enterprise onboarding setup fee' --amount 2500.00 --currency USD --due-days 0`
8. `tenantctl onboarding status --org-id org_acme_industries --require schema,seed,billing,email,invoice --format table`

Rebase a task branch onto `origin/main` and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

## Recent work
Seed step 4 succeeded. Test optimizations produced 318 passed, 4 skipped in 14.92s. Invoice-sync concurrency testing reproduced an intermittent 409: `InvoiceSyncService.submit` forwards the key but does not persist completed responses.
